name: Millennial Party Rock Band
alt: Four band members in sunglasses against a corrugated metal wall, one in a bucket hat and a blue dinosaur-print shirt and one with long hair and a beard.
blurb: Everybody has a song from high school or college that they still know every word to. This band plays those songs for the people who grew up on them, and it's a perfect choice for a wedding reception or a 30th or 40th birthday. It's a lot of fun at a company holiday party, too.
card_line: A party band for weddings, 30th and 40th birthdays, holiday parties and after-parties, playing the rock and pop songs people in their thirties and forties grew up on.
